name: Los Errantes de Chuquibamba
description: '''Los Errantes de Chuquibamba''' ({{Literal translation|The Wanderers of Chuquibamba}}) was an [[Andean music]] group from the town of [[Chuquibamba]], in [[Condesuyos province]], [[department of Arequipa]], [[Peru]]. It was founded by Antonio Alarcón Sierra, Gilberto Eleodoro Cueva Fernández, and Plinio Feliciano Mogrovejo Luque.
